text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe and her Trainer have come to 
watch the Kikuka-sho. As all eyes turn 
toward the race favorite—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The one Neo Universe showed an interest in 
was Hishi Miracle. To the public, she was 
just an ordinary Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However—Hishi Miracle went and truly 
conquered the Kikuka Sho. It wasn't 
something that could be predicted with 
mere ordinary insight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Was it because she could see the future? 
Or was it thanks to her remarkable 
intellect? The truth remained unknown.
